top_signal.title: I have 5+ years of software engineering experience. Looking for a real business problem to solve — completely free.
top_signal.summary: Hey everyone!   I'm a software engineer from India with 5+ years of experience building software applications, backend systems, APIs, integrations, and production-ready solutions.   I've been thinking about something lately.    Building software is becoming cheaper and easier than ever. But understanding what a business actually needs? That's still the difficult part.    Almost every business uses some kind of software today. But generic software doesn't always solve the specific problems that come up in day-to-day operations.   Maybe you're still managing something manually in Excel. Maybe your employees spend hours doing repetitive work. Maybe two systems don't communicate with each other. Or maybe there's a problem you've just learned to live with because you couldn't find the right software.    That's where I'd like to help.    I'm looking for business owners who have real operational problems that could potentially be solved with software.   Here's what I'm offering:     I'll spend time understanding your business, workflows, and the actual problem.   If you're located nearby, I'm happy to visit your workplace and spend a few days observing how things work, if practical.   If you're elsewhere, we can discuss everything remotely.   If there's a feasible solution, I'll design and build it.   I'll help deploy it, stabilize it in production, document it, and hand it over to you or your team.
